{{Quote|Get back as soon as you can and I'll get you a shisha. You can use it in your home as a decoration, or sell it, I don't care either way.|An unidentified criminal to a spacer|<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
A '''shisha''' was an oil pipe used as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] and could have effects on the skin of any organics who used it; most notably the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], whose skin was baggy after using the pipe.

Many affluent travelers would decorate their homes with fine ornamental shishas.<ref name="ItemShisha">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|A Decorative Shisha}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a criminal commissioned a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to carry out a task, promising a decorative shisha in return.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shisha, from the [[Wikipedia:Persian|Persian]] word shīshe, meaning glass, is the common term for the [[Wikipedia:hookah|hookah]] in [[Wikipedia:Egypt|Egypt]].
